name: A Reduced 684-Concept Block-Row Completion
definition: Start with the labelled $267$-concept cornerless ample forbidden pc-minor, replace coordinate $z=0$ by the binary block $\{e,f\}$, and in the nonconstant row add the old word $x=119$. The contraction gains this word with acquired support $P=265=2^0+2^3+2^8$; with $f=11$ and $e=12$, the added concept is $a=2167$.
parameters: The output has $684$ concepts in dimension $13$. Its marked negative overlap has $267$ concepts, its unique corner is $2167$, and that corner has incident support of size three.
properties: It is an ample forbidden pc-minor with minimum degree three and unique corner $2167$. Its thirteen signed-clause columns are pairwise distinct up to sign, so neither the graph three-core reduction nor signed-column reduction changes it. In the zero $e$-section the only possible first relative deletion is $2167$, after which the section stalls; the other section has no relative first move.
